articles.title: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto
articles.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court hasn't yet indicated whether it will take up cases surrounding prediction markets, but there are now several amicus briefs, an interim final rule and a rule proposal.

articles.title: Clarity's failure could speed crypto innovation while shielding incumbents
articles.summary: Executives see openings for tokenization, DeFi and dealmaking, while lawyers warn agency action leaves spot-market oversight and lasting certainty unresolved.

articles.title: President Trump declares 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine
articles.summary: "Ukraine supports the ceasefire, and it is important that Russia support it as well," said Ukrainian President Zelensky.
